items.title: davidkimai/Context-Engineering: "Context engineering is the delicate art and science of filling the context window with just the right information for the next step."

repo_info.description: "Context engineering is the delicate art and science of filling the context window with just the right information for the next step." — Andrej Karpathy. A frontier, first-principles handbook inspired by Karpathy and 3Blue1Brown for moving beyond prompt engineering to the wider discipline of context design, orchestration, and optimization.

items.title: Bernstein
items.description: Multi-agent orchestrator with context-aware model routing. Routes tasks to optimal models based on complexity, manages context across parallel agents.

repo_info.description: Deterministic orchestrator for CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, +40 more). No model in the coordination loop, so parallel runs in per-task git worktrees replay byte-identically. Signed lineage plus an opt-in HMAC audit chain a reviewer checks offline. Cluster mode, air-gap deploy. Status: beta. https://bernstein.run

original_repository_info.description: 🔥 Comprehensive survey on Context Engineering: from prompt engineering to production-grade AI systems. hundreds of papers, frameworks, and  implementation guides for LLMs and AI agents.
